[[File:Glyph_of_power.png|thumb|The glyph.]]
The '''Glyph of Power''' was an ancient [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] symbol. According to legend, it had [[Magic/Legends|magical]] properties to it, which made Ewoks nearby recover faster from tiredness.

The glyph depicted a leaf. [[Ewok glyphs]] would often be carved on trees where Ewoks lived.
